jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (F/H) – FREELANCE
jobs.description:
Télécom

Il y a 2 années

Hybride

Casablanca

BI NEWVISION recrute un Senior Data Engineer
pour l’un de ses clients stratégiques dans le secteur des télécoms.

Profil Recherché :

Formation : BAC+5 (Master ou école d’ingénieur).
Expérience : Minimum 5 ans d’expérience significatif.

Compétences :

Maîtrise de la programmation SQL et capacité à écrire des requêtes SQL complexes
Maîtrise d’un ou plusieurs outils ETL comme Informatica, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Talend ou DataStage, etc et de l’outil Snowflake
Maîtrise d’un ou plusieurs langages de programmation comme Python, Java, C++, etc.
Connaissance des concepts d’entreposage de données et de modélisation de données
Expertise en profilage de données, analyse de données et qualité des données
Familiarité avec les systèmes de bases de données et les réseaux informatiques
Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes
Solides compétences en communication et en collaboration
Souci du détail et capacité à gérer de gros volumes de données
Capacité à travailler sur de multiples projets en parallèle et en autonomie

Missions :

Maintenir les chaînes de traitement existantes (SSIS, SnowSQL, Python), assurer la qualité et la disponibilité des données
Finaliser la migration d’anciennes chaînes de traitement vers notre nouveau datalake Snowflake
Participer aux ateliers avec les équipes métier pour collecter les besoins
Développer de nouvelles chaînes de traitement pour intégrer de nouvelles données dans le datalake (Batch,API)
Implémenter les règles métier pour créer les tables et vues adaptées pour les métiers
Assurer la recette des données avec les PO et les équipes métier
Implémenter des algorithmes plus complexes basés sur le datalake en fonction des besoins (eg. Création d’un référentiel client unique, algorithmes de personnalisation, etc.)

Informations Supplémentaires :

Le poste est en mode Hybride sur Casablanca.
Disponibilité : Rapide.
Démarrage : Imminent.
Contrat : Freelance.

Vous avez envie d’évoluer et vous êtes prêt à relever de nouveaux challenges ? Alors n’attendez plus, postulez !!!

Compétences :

Python Gitlab SQL Server SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) Snowflake

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer – Consumer Data Platform
Location: Paris, France – hybrid
Contract: 6-month freelance contract with extension
Start date: ASAP

The Opportunity

We are looking for two Senior Data Engineers to support the continued development and improvement of an established Consumer Data Platform.

The platform is built using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake and Microsoft Azure, and enables consumer data to support downstream marketing and customer-focused use cases.

With the main platform now established, the focus is on improving its quality, reliability and maintainability. This includes resolving technical debt, strengthening architecture, improving data pipelines and ensuring the platform can continue to scale.

This is a hands-on position for someone who takes ownership of technical challenges and proactively works with the wider team to deliver solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and improve data pipelines using Python and SQL
Build and maintain data transformations using dbt
Work with Snowflake and Azure-based data environments
Improve the reliability and performance of the Consumer Data Platform
Identify and resolve bugs, technical debt and platform weaknesses
Contribute to data architecture and technical design decisions
Investigate issues across upstream and downstream systems
Take ownership of technical problems through to resolution
Collaborate with engineers, architects and business stakeholders
Improve engineering standards, testing and software quality
Communicate blockers clearly and proactively seek solutions

Required Experience
Strong commercial experience as a Senior Data Engineer
Advanced Python and SQL skills
Hands-on experience with dbt
Strong Snowflake experience
Experience working within Microsoft Azure
Experience designing and developing modern data platforms
Good understanding of data architecture, modelling and pipelines
Ability to work independently and manage technical priorities
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
A proactive approach with clear evidence of ownership

Experience working with consumer, customer, retail or marketing data would be beneficial but is not essential.

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be more than a ticket-focused engineer. They will be curious about how the wider platform operates, comfortable working across teams and willing to take responsibility for solving problems.

This opportunity would suit someone who:

Investigates beyond the immediate task
Communicates early when encountering blockers
Understands upstream and downstream dependencies
Takes responsibility for delivering working solutions
Contributes ideas for improving architecture and engineering quality

Working Arrangement
The position is hybrid, with approximately one week per month required in Paris. This can potentially be divided into shorter blocks of on-site attendance.
Additional on-site interaction may be required during the initial onboarding period to support integration with the team.

Interview Process
The selection process includes a technical assessment covering:
Python and SQL
A small dbt project

Candidates should be comfortable demonstrating practical, hands-on knowledge across these areas.

Contract Details
Initial six-month freelance contract
Potential for extension
ASAP start, with reasonable notice periods considered
Paris-based hybrid working
